period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported, Solo/Standalone -- 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)' heading without the 'Consolidated' prefix used elsewhere in the same filing, per project convention of preferring Solo over Consolidated). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2011 (as published in UCB's own standalone unaudited interim financial statement filed on ucb.com.bd's investor-relations Financial Statements archive) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as FY2013-2025. This PDF ('Balance Sheet (Un-audited) 31 March 2011.pdf') is a clean, fully native-text 26-page document requiring no OCR; every figure below was read directly via pdftotext -layout and independently reconciles (Total Assets = Total Liabilities + Equity to the taka; Total Operating Income/Expenses/Provisions all sum correctly). off_balance_sheet_exposures is NOT separately broken out for Solo in this specific filing (only a single Consolidated 'Off Balance Sheet Items' section is presented, unlike most later years which show both) -- the Consolidated figure (BDT 41,184.54m) is used here instead, on the basis that the very next quarter's filing (Q3 2011) explicitly shows IDENTICAL Solo and Consolidated off-balance-sheet totals (BDT 39,243.03m each), i.e. UCB's small non-bank subsidiaries carry no off-balance-sheet exposure of their own, so Consolidated is a reliable proxy for Solo here; this is recorded as 'reported' (it is a genuinely reported figure, just from the Consolidated section) rather than 'calculated'. nav_per_share is not disclosed in this report (UCB's NAVPS note was not yet introduced in 2011); it is independently computed here as Total Shareholders' Equity / (Paid-up Capital / BDT10 par) = 8,113,977,112 / 290,995,350 shares = 27.88, marked 'calculated' since -- unlike several 2017-era quarters -- no later report's comparative column was found covering this specific period to cross-validate against. nocfps_cumulative is not recorded for this quarter as NOCFPS reporting was not yet introduced (same reasoning as UCB's own FY2013 annual-report-embedded table, which also lacks a NOCFPS row for its earliest years).
